generations.label: 2016–2024 SS / 1LE — 6.2L V8 (LT1)

engineOil.note: The LT1 holds a FULL 10 quarts — do not assume the 6–8 qt typical of a V8.
engineOil.buy: Mobil 1 5W-30 dexos1 full synthetic motor oil

coolant.type: Dex-Cool (orange, extended life) — do NOT mix with green coolant

transmission.type: Dexron HP (10L80 10-speed auto) · Dexron VI (TR-6060 6-speed manual)

safety: LT1 holds 10 QUARTS of oil — underfilling to a typical V8's 6–8 qt will starve the engine.
dexos1-certified oil required — check the bottle label.
Belly pan (undertray) must come off for oil-drain access (7 mm + 10 mm fasteners).
Dex-Cool must NOT be mixed with green coolant — mixing gels and clogs the system.
Brembo brakes (SS 1LE): DOT 4 only, bleed with a scan tool for ABS.
